data.title: Kimberly-Clark Hold: Kenvue Acquisition Potential Offset by Integration Risks and Limited Upside
data.description:
Kimberly Clark (KMB) has received a new Hold rating, initiated by Goldman Sachs analyst, Bonnie Herzog.

Bonnie Herzog’s rating is based on several factors that create a balanced outlook for Kimberly-Clark. The acquisition of Kenvue could strengthen the portfolio through greater scale, broader geographic reach, and stronger health and wellness brands. However, integrating the businesses may take longer than expected because Kenvue has weaker operational discipline and elevated inventory levels.

Kimberly-Clark also faces near-term pressure from uneven fundamentals and reputational exposure related to litigation involving Tylenol. These concerns are partly offset by the stock’s discounted valuation versus household and personal-care peers. With limited immediate catalysts and only modest potential upside to the price target, Herzog viewed the risk-reward profile as balanced and therefore supported a Hold rating.

In another report released on November 17, J.P. Morgan also assigned a Hold rating to the stock with a $113.00 price target.
